moves.name: auto
moves.label: Let Selecta pick
moves.description: The best move for these two songs that passes its checks.

moves.name: bass_swap_blend
moves.label: Blend
moves.description: Both songs play in time, and they trade the bass halfway.

moves.name: vocal_ride
moves.label: Vocal ride
moves.description: B's band comes in under A's voice, before B starts singing.
moves.reason: A isn't singing enough near a place it could finish.

moves.name: stem_arrange
moves.label: Strip and land
moves.description: A strips down to its melody, B is teased, then B's bass and drums land.

moves.name: stem_intertwine
moves.label: Intertwined stems
moves.description: Trade drums, bass and harmonic layers over sixteen bars, with vocals taking turns.

moves.name: filter_sweep
moves.label: Filter sweep
moves.description: A filters away upward as B opens up.

moves.name: tempo_ramp
moves.label: Tempo ramp
moves.description: Both songs drift to a shared speed for a short overlap.

moves.name: word_blend
moves.label: Word blend
moves.description: A vocal ride that hands over on a phrase both songs share.
moves.reason: These two songs don't share a phrase at a line end and a line start.

moves.name: word_exchange
moves.label: Call and response
moves.description: The voices trade a phrase over B's band until B keeps it.
moves.reason: These two songs don't share a phrase at a line end and a line start.

moves.name: phrase_roll
moves.label: Phrase roll
moves.description: A's phrase repeats, faster and faster, into B singing it.
moves.reason: These two songs don't share a phrase at a line end and a line start.

moves.name: word_cut
moves.label: Word cut
moves.description: A sets a phrase up, and B sings it.
moves.reason: These two songs don't share a phrase at a line end and a line start.

moves.name: cut_on_one
moves.label: Cut
moves.description: A clean cut onto B's downbeat.

moves.name: echo_out
moves.label: Echo out
moves.description: A's last beat rings on as B lands under it.

moves.name: delay_throw
moves.label: Delay throw
moves.description: A's last word is thrown into a delay as B slams in.

moves.name: reverb_wash
moves.label: Reverb wash
moves.description: A dissolves into a room as B arrives.
